newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 18.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 18.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Police is still looking for Bandi Kiss, the suspected initiator of a Budapest gang war.
- The Interest Coordination Council had a muted debate on the pension reform.
- Hungary aims for a strong presence in south-east Asia and in return is prepared to offer an European bridgehead for those countries, Prime Minister Gyula Horn said in Singapore.
- Hungarian representatives were also elected in the east Slavonian local elections.
- Bank robbers took 4.4 million forints this morning from a branch of OTP Bank.
